blocks.text: OpenRouter 今天正式成为 @stripe 的一部分！

inlines.text: OpenRouter 今天正式成为 @stripe 的一部分！

blocks.text: 超过 1000 万开发者和公司使用 OpenRouter，随着他们在更多工作负载中使用更多模型进行构建，他们需要控制成本以及数据流向。

inlines.text: 超过 1000 万开发者和公司使用 OpenRouter，随着他们在更多工作负载中使用更多模型进行构建，他们需要控制成本以及数据流向。

blocks.text: OpenRouter 已经构建了这套运营基础设施，帮助在每一个模型和提供商上运行 AI，包括获取新模型、在故障期间保持正常运行，以及为每个团队强制执行支出和数据政策。

inlines.text: OpenRouter 已经构建了这套运营基础设施，帮助在每一个模型和提供商上运行 AI，包括获取新模型、在故障期间保持正常运行，以及为每个团队强制执行支出和数据政策。

blocks.text: 加入 Stripe——这家多年来为全球企业运行关键基础设施的公司——意味着我们可以更快地构建它，并支持各种规模的公司。

inlines.text: 加入 Stripe——这家多年来为全球企业运行关键基础设施的公司——意味着我们可以更快地构建它，并支持各种规模的公司。

blocks.text: 我们对中立性的承诺保持不变。模型和提供商在质量、可靠性和价格上竞争。由你决定什么适合你的业务。

blocks.text: OpenRouter is officially part of @stripe today!

inlines.text: OpenRouter is officially part of @stripe today!

blocks.text: More than 10 million developers and companies use OpenRouter, and as they build with more models across more workloads, they need control over what it costs and where their data goes.

inlines.text: More than 10 million developers and companies use OpenRouter, and as they build with more models across more workloads, they need control over what it costs and where their data goes.

blocks.text: OpenRouter has built that operating infrastructure to help run AI across every model and provider, with access to new models, uptime through outages, and enforced spend and data policies for each team.

inlines.text: OpenRouter has built that operating infrastructure to help run AI across every model and provider, with access to new models, uptime through outages, and enforced spend and data policies for each team.

blocks.text: Joining Stripe, which has spent years running critical infrastructure for businesses around the world, means we can build it faster and support companies at every scale.

inlines.text: Joining Stripe, which has spent years running critical infrastructure for businesses around the world, means we can build it faster and support companies at every scale.

blocks.text: Our commitment to neutrality stays the same. Models and providers compete on quality, reliability, and price. You decide what works for your business.
